name: @pipeworx/mcp-twilio

tools.name: twilio_send_sms
tools.description: Send an SMS message via Twilio. Returns the message SID and status.

to.description: Destination phone number in E.164 format (e.g., +15551234567)

from.description: Twilio phone number to send from in E.164 format

tools.name: twilio_list_messages
tools.description: List recent SMS/MMS messages from your Twilio account. Supports filtering by to/from number and pagination.

tools.name: twilio_get_message
tools.description: Get details of a specific Twilio message by its SID.

tools.name: twilio_list_calls
tools.description: List recent phone calls from your Twilio account. Returns call SID, status, duration, and direction.

tools.name: twilio_make_call
tools.description: Initiate a phone call via Twilio. Requires a TwiML URL or application SID to control call behavior.

to.description: Destination phone number in E.164 format

from.description: Twilio phone number to call from in E.164 format

url.description: TwiML URL that controls what happens when the call connects

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-twilio forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the twilio pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
